description: We advise companies, investors and financial institutions on a wide range of corporate and commercial matters in Bangladesh. Our work includes corporate governance, commercial transactions, mergers and acquisitions, private equity, financing, insurance and regulatory issues, with a focus on providing clear and commercially grounded legal counsel.

We advise banks, financial institutions, investors and businesses on a broad range of banking and finance matters, combining detailed knowledge of financial regulation with practical commercial judgment. Our work spans structured finance, syndicated lending, project and asset finance, loan transactions and emerging FinTech matters.

Our dispute resolution practice represents clients in complex commercial disputes and contentious matters in Bangladesh and internationally. We advise and represent clients across litigation, arbitration, negotiation and mediation, combining rigorous legal analysis with strategic judgment to protect their interests.

We advise businesses and organisations in navigating Bangladesh's regulatory landscape and their interactions with key regulatory and governmental authorities. Our work includes regulatory compliance, investment, labour, competition, environmental, tax and corporate registration matters.

description: We advise employers on the legal and practical considerations arising from the cessation and restructuring of employment. Our counsel covers compliance with labour laws, employment regulations, service rules, workplace conduct and workforce restructuring, helping organisations manage employment transitions with clarity and care.

We advise businesses on intellectual property, technology and digital matters across an increasingly regulated and technology-driven economy. Our work covers intellectual property rights, data protection, cyber law, digital infrastructure, telecommunications and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
